description: This file is a PHP source code for a web interface page that manages MoCA network settings, including enabling/disabling MoCA, channel selection, privacy, network password, and related configurations. It includes server-side PHP code for retrieving current settings and client-side JavaScript for UI interactions and AJAX updates.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Handles the form submission, gathers current configuration values, constructs a JSON string, and sends an AJAX POST request to update the MoCA configuration on the backend.
